sources.observation: The stepped central entrance opens through three pilasters and a low balcony toward the lawn. Pale masonry side wings frame the center.

sources.credit: Stemoc / Wikimedia Commons, see image page
sources.observation: The three-storey window rows, terminal pavilions and detached-looking clock over the east wing identify the compound.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see image page
sources.observation: The chamber has tall steel-framed glazing, broad stone pilasters and a recessed ground level.

limitations: Clock height, internal wing subdivisions and exact facade details are estimated from the exterior photographs. Only exterior spaces are modeled.
